headline: Instruction to quickly resolve additional electricity bills for June
summary: Authorities have issued a directive to promptly address and settle any additional electricity charges incurred by consumers for the month of June. This aims to ensure fair billing practices.
details: A directive has been issued to ensure the swift resolution of any additional electricity bills that consumers may have received for the month of June. This instruction aims to address concerns regarding billing discrepancies.

The focus is on promptly settling these extra charges, ensuring transparency and fairness in the billing process for all affected customers. This measure seeks to alleviate potential financial burdens on households and businesses.
The directive underscores the importance of efficient service delivery and consumer satisfaction within the power sector. Relevant authorities are expected to implement the instruction without delay.
caption:
Consumers facing higher-than-expected electricity bills for June will see swift action.

A directive has been issued to ensure the swift resolution of any additional electricity bills that consumers may have received for the month of June. This instruction aims to address concerns regarding billing discrepancies.

The focus is on promptly settling these extra charges, ensuring transparency and fairness in the billing process for all affected customers. This measure seeks to alleviate potential financial burdens on households and businesses.

The directive underscores the importance of efficient service delivery and consumer satisfaction within the power sector. Relevant authorities are expected to implement the instruction without delay.
